title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter
abstract: arXiv:2611.23359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regene

translated_title: 优先排序，而非决策：审计一个已部署的人在环简历排序系统的收获
translated_abstract: 一份学术职位空缺可以吸引数百份申请，而第一轮筛选会占用评审委员会的大部分时间。我们描述了一个部署在国家学术职位空缺平台上、并与该平台职位空缺数据库集成的简历优先级排序器。它为一堆简历提出阅读顺序，而将所有决策留给委员会；该系统将冻结的多语言 Transformer 编码器与一个会话级线性模型相结合，该模型在每次标注后重新训练，并在会话结束时被丢弃。它是有效的：在一个包含 300 份合成简历的池子中，按该工具推荐的顺序阅读的委员会在读完一半简历后即可接触到 95% 的相关候选人，而按任意顺序阅读则需要几乎读完全部简历。本文关注的是我们审计上述声明时的发现，而非系统本身。三个发现改变了产品。其中一个发现是：该简历池仅凭文档长度即可完成排序，这使得在其上使用精确率类指标变得毫无参考意义；重新生成……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文审计了一个部署在国家学术招聘平台上的人在环简历优先排序系统——委员会按其推荐顺序只需阅读一半简历即可覆盖 95% 的相关候选人；审计进一步发现该评测简历池仅凭文档长度即可排序，使精确率类指标失去参考意义，这一发现直接改变了产品设计。
en_tdlr: This paper audits a deployed human-in-the-loop CV priority sorter that lets academic committees reach 95% of relevant candidates after reading only half the pile, and reveals that the evaluation pool is sortable by document length alone, rendering precision-style metrics uninformative.
